The Scanner page renders this number as a heading — 'Competitors Priced Above Market (306) — not counted in my KPIs' — but the collapsible list itself only ever shows 50 (frontend slices to 50 of the 100 returned). rca of the issue: The client saw a competitor's 179.52 SAR rendered as 'YOUR PRICE' next to a 99 SAR 'Market lowest'. Root cause (confirmed by code review of server.py:5464 area and by the shape of the current live response): the old endpoint emitted one opportunities row PER SELLER and put THAT seller's price into a field literally called `my_price`, which the page renders as YOUR PRICE. Additionally the detail-panel bar chart was built by filtering the opportunities list, which only carried sellers >=10% above the market low, so the store DEFINING the market low was never drawn. Fix (verified live): opportunities is now one-row-per-OWN-product; store_name/store_id are always Pets Houses; the sellers array carries every store (own + competitors), sorted ascending, with is_own/is_lowest/is_highest flags computed BEFORE the slice, so the chart always contains the market low; competitor rows are moved to a separate `competitors_overpriced` list that never counts against MY KPIs. Uplift is now gap × units WE sold in the window (0 in preview because the sales ledger is empty — expected, not a bug per the review note).
